title: 第1章 最强仙尊重生第2章 谁敢对小神医不敬
lines: 九星连珠日，天生异象，万里无云的天空瞬间雷云密闭，紫电青雷倾泻，宛若世界末日！
“咔嚓！”
一道闪电几乎将天都要劈碎，雷霆之中，有神光闪烁而过……
与此同时，开往中海市的动车上，一名少年缓缓睁开眼眸，少年年纪不大，可那双眸子却饱经沧桑，好似度过了无数岁月。
“这里是……地球？”
“我没有陨落在神劫中，而是重生回了少年时代？”
唐明神情一震，面色难掩惊骇。
他原本是金陵唐家大少，被陷害逐出家族，脚筋挑断，一生碌碌无为含恨而终，却机缘巧合下，获得仙道传承。
从修为最低的散修，一步步修炼，成长到令漫天仙佛都颤栗的仙道霸主。
玄天战尊唐明，执掌一界，生杀予夺！
他或许不是修为最高的仙尊，但绝对是战力最为霸道猛烈的帝尊，五百年征战不休，陨落在他手中的界域仙尊，足有六位。
可惜。
在最后关头飞升神界中，被十五位界域仙尊联手围剿，最终在万古神劫中陨落。
“神无忧，帝姬，你二人胆敢背叛本尊！”
“待我重回玄天界，定要血海滔天，将你二人永镇冥狱！”
唐明眼眸中闪过一道极致杀意。
帝尊一怒，山河倾覆，界域崩塌。
“轰隆隆——”
咔嚓。
一道剧烈的紫电青雷，震得大地颤抖。
“尊敬的各位乘客大家好，突遇雷暴天气，为防止意外，本次动车将会停靠五分钟，请大家切勿慌乱……”
动车上，传来语音播报声。
唐明回过神来，当他看向自己右腿时，漆黑的眸子，凝聚出一抹摄人寒意。
他的腿，是瘸的。
是被金陵唐家，他的亲二伯唐安顺，派人挑断脚筋而瘸。
“前世，我被挑断脚筋，驱逐唐家成为废人一个，虽得柳姨收留照顾，却依旧郁郁而终。”
“金陵唐家，你们做好迎接本尊的报复了吗？”
唐明呢喃开口，周身的温度骤降。
仙界沉沦五百年，登顶玄天战尊，可在神劫之中，他却发现自己心境上的缺陷，那就是前世世俗中的种种遗憾。
心生遗憾，则道心不满；道心不满，如何渡过万古神劫？
这一世。
他要一步步修炼，将每个境界打磨至巅峰，将每个遗憾弥补完美，然后成就玄天战尊，渡过万古神劫。
content_en:
Nine stars in a row, a natural phenomenon, the cloudless sky is instantly sealed with thunderclouds, purple lightning and green thunder pour down, it's like the end of the world!
"Crack!"
A bolt of lightning almost split the sky into pieces, and in the thunder, a divine light flashed past...
At the same time, on the high-speed train bound for Zhonghai City, a young man slowly opened his eyes. The young man was not very young, but his eyes were weathered, as if he had spent countless years.
"This is...Earth?"
"I didn't fall into the divine calamity, but was reborn as a boy?"
Tang Ming was shocked and could not hide his horror.
He was originally the eldest son of the Tang family in Jinling. He was framed and expelled from the family. His hamstring was broken. He ended his life in inaction and resentment. However, by chance, he received the inheritance of immortality.
From a casual cultivator with the lowest level of cultivation, he practiced step by step and grew to an immortal overlord who made all the immortals and Buddhas in the sky tremble.
Xuantian War Lord Tang Ming is in charge of an entire world, taking life and death for granted!
He may not be the Immortal Lord with the highest cultivation level, but he is definitely the Emperor with the most domineering and fierce fighting power. After five hundred years of endless battles, six Realm Immortal Lords fell in his hands.
pity.
At the last moment, he ascended to the God Realm, and was surrounded and suppressed by fifteen Realm Immortal Lords, and finally fell in the eternal divine tribulation.
"Shen Wuyou, Di Ji, how dare you two betray me!"
"When I return to the Xuantian Realm, I will definitely unleash a sea of blood and keep you two in Hell forever!"
Tang Ming's eyes flashed with extreme murderous intent.
When the emperor was angry, mountains and rivers overturned, and the realm collapsed.
"Rumble--"
Click.
A violent purple lightning and green thunder shook the ground.
"Hello, dear passengers, there is a sudden thunderstorm. To prevent accidents, this train will stop for five minutes. Please do not panic..."
On the train, a voice announcement came.
Tang Ming came back to his senses. When he looked at his right leg, his dark eyes condensed a chilling feeling.
His legs are lame.
It was his second uncle Tang Anshun from the Tang family in Jinling who sent someone to break his hamstrings and made him lame.
"In my previous life, my hamstring was broken and I was expelled from the Tang family and became a useless person. Although Aunt Liu took care of me, I still died in depression."
"Jinling Tang Family, are you ready to receive my revenge?"
Tang Ming murmured, and the temperature around his body dropped sharply.
The fairy world has been in decline for five hundred years, and he has reached the summit of Xuantian War Lord. However, during the divine calamity, he discovered the flaws in his state of mind, which were all the regrets in his previous life.
If you have regrets in your heart, your Taoist heart will be dissatisfied; if your Taoist heart is dissatisfied, how will you survive the eternal divine calamity?
This life.
He will practice step by step, polish each realm to its peak, make up for every regret to perfection, and then become the Xuantian War Lord and survive the eternal divine tribulation.
